items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Joe Watkin was his drummer and such. Well, they were real tight those two.

ctx.x: I see. How long were you with Howard?

Well, obviously I played with Howard up until he'd taken sick. Until he'd give up. I fell on with him. When he went. Off and on. Yeah, off and on. Then when he went with George Lewis, well he even tried to get me when Jill Watkin had taken sick away from here first time. He tried to get me to come up there to play with the band and I think it was in Cincinnati. He always kept his mind on me. But something happened or I think they had to have a drummer right away and they hired somebody else. That was the first…
Wonderful. Wonderful. Well I like his style and everything. I do too. And he's world famous now. Yes. But you played on Bourbon Street too. Yeah well like I said I played Bourbon Street.
